business: The Pearl Dermatology and Laser Centre
summary: Two Doha branches and decades of experience are strong, but a dead menu link, repeated blocks and a booking form that appears to show no fields lose patients.

findings.problem: The Branches menu item links to #, the Accent Prime Body Contour page uses a generic address, and the Welcome to heading appears twice with no text under it.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot find your two branches and the page looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Working menus and a clear branch page.

findings.problem: The expert is named Dr.Hala Taher in one place and Dr. Hala Haj Tajer in another, and the centre is spelled Centre and Center.
findings.cost: Changing names weaken trust and search visibility.
findings.fix: One consistent name for the clinic and doctor.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to show labels and a Send button without visible fields, and bookings are not confirmed until a helpdesk call.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book now may leave instead of waiting for a call.
findings.fix: A working form with branch and time choice and WhatsApp booking.

findings.problem: One testimonial has a name but no text, before and after photos have no captions, and most images appear to be blank placeholders with no alt text.
findings.cost: Proof is thin where patients decide.

redesign: Working branch pages and one booking path with WhatsApp.
Consistent doctor and clinic names across the site.
Full reviews and captioned before and after results.
